Subject: AWS co-sell: Silvershore marketplace listing + request for intro

Hi Jonas —

Quick intro: I’m Mike Jansen on the AWS ISV partner team, and I’m looping in Maria Gomez from Silvershore (their Head of Platform) — they’re evaluating a marketplace listing + co-sell engagement to accelerate procurement and get AWS help qualifying the opportunity.

High-level ask: can you take a short bridge call next week to confirm scope (API access, data residency), map the mutual action plan, and surface any required docs for marketplace listing?

A few constraints from the customer:
- Production deployment must support VPC/private connectivity and audit logs
- SOC2 evidence will be needed for procurement (timeline: 6–8 weeks)
- Target initial POC: 100 active users, then scale to 3k/month tokens

Suggested attendees: you (Redwood AE), a solutions lead (technical), Maria (customer), AWS partner manager (me).

Thanks — appreciate a quick reply with availability.

Mike Jansen
Senior Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
Amazon Web Services

Thanks for the intro — welcome, Maria. I’d be happy to run the bridge call and map out a pragmatic roadmap for marketplace listing + co-sell. I’m copying Laura (solutions partner) and Karthik (pricing & procurement) so we can answer technical and contract questions on the call.

Proposed 30–45 minute agenda:
1) Quick intros & success metrics for POC (5–7 min)
2) Requirements and constraints (VPC, logging, SOC2) — Maria (10 min)
3) Proposed deployment + cost profile (Redwood) — Laura (10 min)
4) Marketplace listing path & AWS co-sell handoff (Mike) — (5 min)
5) Next steps & MAP action owners (5–10 min)

I attached a short mutual action plan template to capture owners and timelines — we’ll fill it during the call. Please let us know which of these windows work for you next week:
- Wed 2027-06-23: 10:00–11:00 PDT
- Thu 2027-06-24: 14:00–15:00 PDT
- Fri 2027-06-25: 08:30–09:15 PDT

If none work, send a calendar link and we’ll accommodate.

Cheers,

jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128
